sentences.text:
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

By way of the present application, petitioner seeks following reliefs:-
"(i) Issue a Writ of Certiorari or any other appropriate writ, order, or direction to quash FIR No. 190/2017 dated 12.05.2017, registered at PS Hari Nagar, under Sections 498A/34 IPC (ii) Issue a Writ of Certiorari to set aside the Order dated 04.10.2024 passed by the Ld. JMFC (Mahila Court-02), West District, Tis Hazari Courts, declaring the Petitioner as an Absconder in CC No. 62/2/19 (iii) Issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the Respondents not to take any coercive action against the Petitioner in connection with the subject FIR;"
This is a digitally signed order.
